question: Which of the following players won Silver at the Tokyo Olympics 2020?

options.text: Ravi Kumar Dahiya and Mirabai Chanu
Ravi Kumar Dahiya and Sushil Kumar

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ravi Kumar Dahiya and Mirabai Chanu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mirabai Chanu:-**

 
 
• Mirabai Chanu is an Indian weightlifter who has won several medals in international competitions including the Commonwealth Games and the World Championships.
 
• She won the Silver medal in the women's 49 kg weightlifting event at the Tokyo Olympics 2020.
 
 
 
• **Ravi Kumar Dahiya:-**
 
 
• Ravi Kumar Dahiya is an Indian wrestler who won the Silver medal at the Tokyo Olympics 2020 in the men's freestyle 57 kg wrestling event.
 
• He had also won a Bronze medal at the World Championships in 2019. 
 
• He won the Silver medal in the men's freestyle 57 kg wrestling event at the Tokyo Olympics 2020. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sushil Kumar:-**

 
 
• He is an Indian wrestler who has won multiple medals at the Olympics, Commonwealth Games, and Asian Games. However, he was not a part of the Indian contingent at the Tokyo Olympics 2020.
 
 
 
• **PV Sindhu:-**
 
 
• She is an Indian badminton player who won the Silver medal at the Rio Olympics 2016 and the Bronze medal at the Tokyo Olympics 2020. 
 
• PV Sindhu won the Bronze medal in the women's singles badminton event at the Tokyo Olympics 2020.
 
 
 
• **Sushil Kumar:-**
 
 
• He did not participate in the Tokyo Olympics 2020 as he was facing criminal charges and was also suspended by the Wrestling Federation of India.
